Feature and schema decision receipt

Copy into your working project. Empty fields are unknown, not accepted.

Identity and evidence

  • Exercise / interview/source version:
  • Participant / date / workshop decision owner:
  • Live HVE or desk walkthrough:
  • Actual selected project and available run/artifact references:
  • Business outcome, constraints and unanswered questions:

Original outputs

Requested labels identify content, not real IDs or filenames.

Prompt / label Actual run or navigation-only read-back Original artifact/version/path Run / mirror / review states

Feature decisions

Feature ID Client need/source Value and technology implication First / later / rejected / unverified Choice and alternative considered

Schema rationale

Entity / field / relationship Supporting selected feature IDs Purpose and logical type / cardinality Requiredness / ownership / history Smaller alternative and tradeoff

Do not add a field just because a starter template or product has it. Record why an included feature needs it and what would be lost without it.

Change and model walkthrough

  • Changed client requirement:
  • Feature/schema consequences:
  • Included now versus deferred, with reason:
  • Sample records walked and any model gap:
  • Supplied fictional review findings versus actual HVE/other observations:

Disposition and transfer

  • Use for next design request / revise / hold, with source-backed reason:
  • Human decisions still open:
  • Receiver's explanation and help needed:
  • Reusable decision pattern and client-specific facts to replace:
  • Next prototype/build question and owner:

A workshop disposition is not operator approval, server acceptance, an implemented schema or a passed runtime test. Any actual implementation/evaluation is recorded separately.
